verses.en: And YAHUAH called unto Mosheh, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ሙሴን ጠርቶ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto YAHUAH, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራችው። ከእናንተ ማናቸውም ሰው ለእግዚአብሔር መባ ሲያቀርብ መባችሁን ከእንስሳ ወገን ከላሞች ወይም ከበጎች ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before YAHUAH.
verses.am: መባውም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከላሞች መንጋ ቢሆን፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ተባቱን ያቀርባል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዲሠምር በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ፊት ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.am: እጁንም በሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፤ ያስተሰርይለትም ዘንድ የሠመረ ይሆንለታል።

verses.en: And he shall kill the bullock before YAHUAH: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: በሬውንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ ደሙን ያቀርባሉ፤ ደሙንም በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ፊት ባለው በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.en: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት ይገፍፈዋል፥ በየብልቱም ይቈርጠዋል።

verses.en: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
verses.am: የካህኑም የአሮን ልጆች በመሠዊያው ላይ እሳት ያነድዳሉ፥ በእሳቱም ላይ እንጨት ይደረድራሉ፤

verses.en: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ የተቈረቱትን ብልቶች ራሱንም ስቡንም በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ይረበርቡታል፤

verses.en: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹን ግን በውኃ ያጥባል፤ ካህኑም ሁሉን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
verses.am: ቍርባኑም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከበጎች ወይም ከፍየሎች ቢሆን፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ተባቱን ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before YAHUAH: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
verses.am: በመሠዊያውም አጠገብ በሰሜን ወገን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.en: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.am: በየብልቱም ራሱንም ስቡንም ይቈርጠዋል፤ ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ይረበርበዋል፤

verses.en: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹን ግን በውኃ ያጥባል። ካህኑም ሁሉን አቅርቦ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የእሳት ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጣፋጭ ሽታ ነው።

verses.en: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to YAHUAH be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም የሚቀርበው ቍርባን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከወፎች ቢሆን፥ ቍርባኑን ከዋኖስ ወይም ከርግብ ያቀርባል።

verses.en: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
verses.am: ካህኑም ወደ መሠዊያው ያቀርበዋል፥ ራሱንም ይቈለምመዋል፥ በመሠዊያውም ላይ ያቃጥለዋል። ደሙም በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ይንጠፈጠፋል፤

verses.en: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
verses.am: የሆድ ዕቃውንም ከላባዎች ጋር ለይቶ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ በምሥራቅ ወገን በአመዱ ስፍራ ይጥለዋል፤

verses.en: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: በክንፎቹም ይቀድደዋል፥ ነገር ግን አይከፍለውም። ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የእሳት ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጣፋጭ ሽታ ነው።

verses.en: And when any will offer a meat offering unto YAHUAH, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው የእህል ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ሲያቀርብ ቍርባኑ ከመልካም ዱቄት ይሁን፤ ዘይትም ያፈስስበታል፥ ዕጣንም ይጨምርበታል፤

verses.en: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto YAHUAH:
verses.am: ወደ አሮንም ልጆች ወደ ካህናቱ ያመጣዋል፤ ከመልካም ዱቄቱና ከዘይቱም አንድ እፍኝ ሙሉና ዕጣኑን ሁሉ ወስዶ ካህኑ የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ለመታሰቢያ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of YAHUAH made by fire.
verses.am: ከእህሉም ቍርባን የተረፈው ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ይሆናል፤ ይህም ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሆን የእሳት ቍርባን ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.am: በእቶን የተጋገረውን የእህል ቍርባን ስታቀርብ በዘይት የተለወሰ የመልካም ዱቄት የቂጣ እንጐቻ ወይም በዘይት የተቀባ ስስ ቂጣ ይሁን።

verses.en: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
verses.am: ቍርባንህም በምጣድ የተጋገረ የእህል ቍርባን ቢሆን፥ በዘይት የተለወሰ የመልካም ዱቄት ቂጣ ይሁን።

verses.en: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.
verses.am: ቈርሰህም ዘይት ታፈስስበታለህ፤ የእህል ቍርባን ነው።

verses.en: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.am: ቍርባንህም በመቀቀያ የበሰለ የእህል ቍርባን ቢሆን፥ ዘይት የገባበት ከመልካም ዱቄት የተደረገ ይሁን።

verses.en: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto YAHUAH: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
verses.am: ከዚህም የተደረገውን የእህል ቍርባን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ታመጣለህ፤ ለካህኑም ይሰጣል፥ እርሱም ወደ መሠዊያው ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከእህሉ ቍርባን መታሰቢያውን አንሥቶ የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of YAHUAH made by fire.
verses.am: ከእህሉም ቍርባን የተረፈው ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ይሆናል፤ ይህም ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሆን የእሳት ቍርባን ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto YAHUAH, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of YAHUAH made by fire.
verses.am: እርሾ ያለበት ነገር ማርም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን ይሆን ዘንድ አታቀርቡምና ለእግዚአብሔር የምታቀርቡት የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ እርሾ አይሁንበት።

verses.en: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto YAHUAH: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
verses.am: እነዚህንም የበኵራት ቍርባን አድርጋችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ታቀርባላችሁ፤ እንደ ጣፋጭ ሽታ ግን በመሠዊያው ላይ አይቃጠሉም።

verses.en: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy YAHUAH to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
verses.am: የምታቀርበውን የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ በጨው ታጣፍጠዋለህ፤ የአምላክህንም ቃል ኪዳን ጨው ከእህል ቍርባንህ አታጐድልም፤ በቍርባንህ ሁሉ ላይ ጨው ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto YAHUAH, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.
verses.am: ከበኵራትም የእህል ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ብታቀርብ ስለዚህ ቍርባን በእሳት የተጠበሰና የተፈተገ የእህል እሸት ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.
verses.am: ዘይትም ታፈስስበታለህ፥ ዕጣንም ትጨምርበታለህ፤ የእህል ቍርባን ነው።

verses.en: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከተፈተገው እህል ከዘይቱም ወስዶ ከዕጣኑ ሁሉ ጋር መታሰቢያውን ያቃጥላል፤ ይህ ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን ነው።

verses.en: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ቍርባኑም የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ቢሆን፥ ከላሞች መንጋ ተባት ወይም እንስት ቢያቀርብ፥ ነውር የሌለበትን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቅርብ።

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.am: እጁንም ለቍርባን በቀረበው ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፥ በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.en: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto YAHUAH; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.am: ከደኅንነቱም መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ ያቀርባል፤ የሆድ ዕቃውን የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጆች ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ጋር በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ያቃጥሉታል፤ የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ ነው።

verses.en: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto YAHUAH be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርበው ቍርባኑ ከበጎች ተባት ወይም እንስት ቢሆን፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ያቀርባል።

verses.en: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ለቍርባኑ ጠቦትን ቢያቀርብ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቀርበዋል፤

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.am: እጁንም ለቍርባን በቀረበው ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.en: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto YAHUAH; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.am: ከደኅንነቱም መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ ያቀርባል፤ ስቡን፥ እስከ ጀርባውም ድረስ የተቈረጠ ላቱን ሁሉ፥ የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ በእሳት ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር የተደረገ የቍርባን መብል ነው።

verses.en: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ቍርባኑም ፍየል ቢሆን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቀርበዋል፤

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
verses.am: እጁንም በራሱ ላይ ይጭንበታል፥ በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.en: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto YAHUAH; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.am: ከእርሱም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ ያቀርበዋል፤ ሆድ ዕቃውን የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is YAHUAH's.
verses.am: ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ በእሳት ላይ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የተደረገ መብል ነው። ስቡ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
verses.am: ስብና ደም እንዳትበሉ በምትኖሩበት ሁሉ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ነው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of YAHUAH concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ማናቸውም ሰው ሳያውቅ ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥሩ ካላቸው ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን ቢተላለፍ፥

verses.en: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto YAHUAH for a sin offering.
verses.am: የተቀባውም ካህን በሕዝቡ ላይ በደል እንዲቈጠርባቸው ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ ስለ ሠራው ስለ ኃጢአቱ ነውር የሌለበት ወይፈን ለእግዚአብሔር ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before YAHUAH; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ወይፈኑንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያመጣዋል፤ እጁንም በወይፈኑ ራስ ላይ ይጭነዋል፥ ወይፈኑንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል።

verses.en: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.am: የተቀባውም ካህን ከወይፈኑ ደም ወስዶ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ያመጣዋል፤

verses.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before YAHUAH, before the vail of the sanctuary.
verses.am: ካህኑም ጣቱን በደሙ ውስጥ ነክሮ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመቅደሱ መጋረጃ ፊት ደሙን ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጨዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before YAHUAH, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: ካህኑም በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያለው ጣፋጭ ዕጣን በሚታጠንበት መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ላይ ከደሙ ያደርጋል፤ የተረፈውንም የወይፈኑን ደም ሁሉ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጅ ባለው ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.am: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት ከሚታረደው ወይፈን ስብን ሁሉ ይወስዳል፤ ሆድ ዕቃውን የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር፥

verses.en: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
verses.am: ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ከታረደው ወይፈን እንደ ተወሰደው ይወስዳል። ካህኑም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,
verses.am: የወይፈኑን ቁርበት፥ ሥጋውንም ሁሉ፥ ራሱንም፥ እግሮቹንም፥ ሆድ ዕቃውንም፥

verses.en: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
verses.am: ፈርሱንም፥ ወይፈኑን ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ አመድ ወደሚፈስስበት ወደ ንጹሕ ስፍራ ይወስደዋል፥ በእንጨትም ላይ በእሳት ያቃጥለዋል፤ አመድ በሚፈስስበት ስፍራ ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: And if the whole congregation of Yisra'el sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of YAHUAH concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;
verses.am: የእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ ቢስቱ፥ ነገሩም ከጉባኤው ፊት ቢሸሸግ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥሩ ካላቸው ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን ቢተላለፉ፥

verses.en: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: እንዲህም ቢበድሉ፥ የሠሩት ኃጢአት ሲታወቅ ጉባኤው ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ወይፈንን ያቀርባሉ፤ ወደ መገናኛውም ድንኳን ፊት ያመጡታል።

verses.en: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before YAHUAH: and the bullock shall be killed before YAHUAH.
verses.am: የጉባኤውም ሽማግሌዎች እጆቻቸውን በወይፈኑ ራስ ላይ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይጭናሉ፤ ወይፈኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይታረዳል።

verses.en: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.am: የተቀባውም ካህን ከወይፈኑ ደም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ያመጣል፤

verses.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before YAHUAH, even before the vail.
verses.am: ካህኑም ጣቱን በደሙ ውስጥ ነክሮ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመጋረጃው ፊት ለፊት ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጨዋል።

verses.en: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before YAHUAH, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ውስጥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ባለው በዕጣን መሠዊያው ቀንዶች ላይ ከደሙ ያደርጋል፤ ደሙንም ሁሉ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጅ ባለው ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.
verses.am: ስቡንም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ወስዶ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
verses.am: እንዲህም በወይፈኑ ያደርጋል፤ ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት በታረደው ወይፈን እንዳደረገ እንዲሁ በዚህ ያደርጋል፤ ካህኑም ስለ እነርሱ ያስተሰርያል፥ እነርሱም ይቅር ይባላሉ።

verses.en: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.
verses.am: ወይፈኑንም ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ ይወስደዋል፥ የፊተኛውንም ወይፈን እንዳቃጠለ ያቃጥለዋል፤ ይህ የማኅበሩ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of YAHUAH his YAHUAH concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;
verses.am: አንድ መኰንንም ኃጢአትን ሲሠሩ፥ ሳያውቅም እግዚአብሔር አምላኩ። አትሥራ ያለውን ትእዛዝ ሲተላለፍ፥ እንዲህም ሲበድል፥

verses.en: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
verses.am: የሠራው ኃጢአት ቢታወቅ፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ተባት ፍየል ለቍርባኑ ያቀርበዋል፤

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before YAHUAH: it is a sin offering.
verses.am: በፍየሉም ራስ ላይ እጁን ይጭናል፤ የሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል፤ እርሱ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ደም በጣቱ ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ያደርገዋል፤ የተረፈውንም ደም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከሚሆነው መሠዊያ በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.am: ስቡንም ሁሉ እንደ ደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ስብ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል። ካህኑም ኃጢአቱን ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of YAHUAH concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
verses.am: ከአገሩ ሕዝብም አንድ ሰው ኃጢአትን ሳያውቅ ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥራ ያለውን ትእዛዝ ቢተላለፍ፥ ቢበድልም፥

verses.en: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
verses.am: ለእርሱም የሠራው ኃጢአት ቢታወቀው፥ ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ነውር የሌለባትን እንስት ፍየል ለቍርባኑ ያመጣል።

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
verses.am: እጁንም በኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፤ የሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ የኃጢአትን መስዋዕት ያርዳል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከደምዋ በጣቱ ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ላይ ያደርገዋል፥ ደሙንም ሁሉ ከመሠዊያው በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto YAHUAH; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.am: ስቡም ሁሉ ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ላይ እንደሚወሰድ፥ ስብዋን ሁሉ ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ ካህኑም ስለ እርሱ ያስተሰርያል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
verses.am: ስለ ኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት የበግ ጠቦት ቢያቀርብ፥ ነውር የሌለባትን እንስት ያመጣል።

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
verses.am: እጁንም በኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፥ የሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ያርዳታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:
verses.am: ካህኑም ከኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ደም በጣቱ ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ላይ ያደርገዋል፥ ደሙንም ሁሉ ከመሠዊያው በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto YAHUAH: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.am: ስቡ ሁሉ ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ከታረደው ጠቦት ላይ እንደሚወሰድ ስብዋን ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም ለእግዚአብሔር በእሳት በተቃጠለው ቍርባን ላይ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል። ካህኑም ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.am: ማንም ሰው የሚያምለውን ቃል ቢሰማ፥ ምስክር ሆኖም አንድ ነገር አይቶ እንደ ሆነ ወይም አውቆ እንደ ሆነ ባይናገር፥ ኃጢአት መሥራቱ ነውና በደሉን ይሸከማል።

verses.en: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ሳይታወቀው ርኩስ ነገር ቢነካ፥ የረከሰም አውሬ በድን፥ ወይም የረከሰ ከብት በድን፥ ወይም የረከሰ የተንቀሳቀሰ እንስሳ በድን ቢሆን፥ እርሱም ርኩስ ቢሆን ነገሩ በታወቀው ጊዜ በደል ይሆንበታል፤

verses.en: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.
verses.am: ወይም ርኩስነቱን ሳይውቅ ርኩስን ሰው ቢነካ፥ በማናቸውም ርኵሰት ቢረክስ፥ ነገሩ በታወቀው ጊዜ በደል ይሆንበታል።

verses.en: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ሳያውቅ ክፉን ወይም መልካምን ያደርግ ዘንድ ሳያስብ በከንፈሩ ተናግሮ ቢምል፤ ሳያስብ የማለው ስለ ማናቸውም ነገር ቢሆን፤ በታወቀው ጊዜ ከዚህ ነገር በአንዱ በደለኛ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:
verses.am: ከእነዚህ ነገሮች በአንዲቱ በደለኛ ሲሆን፥ የሠራውን ኃጢአት ይናዘዛል።

verses.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto YAHUAH for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.
verses.am: ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ለእግዚአብሔር የበደል መሥዋዕት ያመጣል፤ እርሱም ከመንጋው የበግ ወይም የፍየል እንስት ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ይሆናል፤ ካህኑም ስለ ኃጢአቱ ያስተሰርይለታል።

verses.en: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto YAHUAH; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
verses.am: ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ለበደል መሥዋዕት ጠቦትን ለማምጣት ገንዘቡ ያልበቃ እንደ ሆነ፥ ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች፥ አንዱን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሁለተኛውንም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርባል።

verses.en: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:
verses.am: ወደ ካህኑም ያመጣቸዋል፤ እርሱም አስቀድሞ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሆነውን ያቀርባል፥ ራሱንም ከአንገቱ ይቈለምመዋል፥ ነገር ግን አይቈርጠውም።

verses.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.
verses.am: ከኃጢአቱም መሥዋዕት ደም በመሠዊያው ግድግዳ ላይ ይረጨዋል፤ የተረፈውም ደም ከመሠዊያው በታች ይንጠፈጠፋል፤ እርሱ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.am: እንደ ሥርዓቱም ሁለተኛውን ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያዘጋጀዋል። ካህኑም ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.
verses.am: ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች ለማምጣት ገንዘቡ ያልበቃ እንደ ሆነ፥ ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል መልካም ዱቄት ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል፤ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነውና ዘይት አያፈስስበትም፥ ዕጣንም አይጨምርበትም።

verses.en: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto YAHUAH: it is a sin offering.
verses.am: ወደ ካህኑም ያመጣዋል፥ ካህኑም መታሰቢያው ይሆን ዘንድ ከእርሱ እፍኝ ሙሉ ይውሰድ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም በእሳት በተቃጠለው ቍርባን ላይ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ እርሱም የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከእነዚያ በአንዳቸው ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል። የተረፈውም እንደ እህል ቍርባን ለካህኑ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of YAHUAH; then he shall bring for his trespass unto YAHUAH a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ቢበድል፥ ሳያውቅም ለእግዚአብሔር በተቀደሰው በማናቸውም ነገር ኃጢአትን ቢሠራ፥ ለበደል መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር ከመንጋ ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ በግ ያቀርባል፤ እንደ ግምጋሜህ መጠን በብር ሰቅል እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ለበደል መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.am: በተቀደሰ ነገር ላይ ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ዕዳ ይከፍላል፥ አምስተኛውንም እጅ ይጨምርበታል፥ ለካህኑም ይሰጠዋል። ካህኑም በበደል መሥዋዕት አውራ በግ ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of YAHUAH; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥሩ ካላቸው ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን ቢተላለፍ፥ ባያውቅም፥ ያ ሰው በደለኛ ነው፥ ኃጢአቱንም ይሸከማል።

verses.en: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.am: ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ በግ ከመንጋው ለበደል መሥዋዕት እንደ ግምጋሜህ መጠን ወደ ካህኑ ያመጣዋል፤ ካህኑም ሳያውቅ ስለ ሳተው ስሕተት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against YAHUAH.
verses.am: እርሱም የበደል መሥዋዕት ነው፤ በእውነት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በደለኛ ነው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against YAHUAH, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ኃጢአትን ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ቢበድል፥ ያኖረበትን አደራ ወይም ብድር ወስዶ ባልንጀራውን ቢክድ፥ ወይም ቢቀማ፥ ወይም በባልንጀራው ላይ ግፍ ቢያደርግ፥

verses.en: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:
verses.am: ወይም የጠፋውን ነገር ቢያገኝ፥ ያንንም ሸሽጎ በሐሰት ቢምል፥ ሰው ከሚያደርጋቸው ከእነዚህ ነገሮች ሁሉ በአንዲቱ ቢበድል፥

verses.en: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,
verses.am: እርሱ ኃጢአትን ሠርቶ በደለኛ ቢሆን፥ በቅሚያ የወሰደውን ወይም በግፍ የተቀበለውን ወይም የተሰጠውን አደራ ወይም ጠፍቶ ያገኘውን፥

verses.en: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.
verses.am: ወይም በሐሰት የማለበትን ነገር ይመልስ፤ በሙሉ ይመልስ፥ ከዚያም በላይ አምስተኛውን ክፍል ጨምሮ የበደሉን መሥዋዕት በሚያቀርብበት ቀን ለባለ ገንዘቡ ይስጠው።

verses.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto YAHUAH, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
verses.am: ስለ በደል መሥዋዕትም ለእግዚአብሔር ከመንጋው ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ በግ እንደ ግምጋሜህ መጠን ስለ በደል መሥዋዕት ወደ ካህኑ ያምጣ።

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before YAHUAH: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.
verses.am: ካህኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ ስለዚያም ስላደረገው በደል ሁሉ ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
verses.am: አሮንንና ልጆቹን እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው። የሚቃጠለው የመሥዋዕቱ ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በመሠዊያው ላይ ባለው እንጨት ላይ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ እስኪጸባ ድረስ ይሆናል፤ እሳቱም በመሠዊያው ላይ ዘወትር ይነድዳል።

verses.en: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
verses.am: ካህኑም የበፍታ ቀሚስና የበፍታ ሱሪ በሥጋው ላይ ይለብሳል፤ በመሠዊያውም ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት እሳቱ ከበላው በኋላ አመዱን አንሥቶ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
verses.am: ልብሱንም ያወልቃል፥ ሌላም ልብስ ይለብሳል፤ አመዱንም ተሸክሞ ከሰፈሩ ንጹሕ ስፍራ ወደ ሆነ ወደ ውጭ ያወጣዋል።

verses.en: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.am: እሳቱም በመሠዊያው ላይ ዘወትር ይነድዳል፥ አይጠፋም፤ ካህኑም ማለዳ ማለዳ እንጨት ያቃጥልበታል፤ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት በዚያ ላይ ይረበርባል፤ በዚያም የደኅንነትን መሥዋዕት ስብ ያቃጥላል።

verses.en: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
verses.am: ዘወትር በመሠዊያው ላይ እሳት ይነድዳል፤ አይጠፋም።

verses.en: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before YAHUAH, before the altar.
verses.am: የእህሉም ቍርባን ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ የአሮን ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመሠዊያው ፊት ያቀርቡታል።

verses.en: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከእህሉ ቍርባን መልካሙን ዱቄት ከዘይት ጋር እፍኝ ሙሉ፥ ደግሞም በእህሉ ቍርባን ላይ ያለውን ዕጣን ሁሉ ያነሣል፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ለመታሰቢያ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
verses.am: ከእርሱም የተረፈውን አሮንና ልጆቹ ይበሉታል፤ ቂጣ ሆኖ በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይበላል፤ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዙሪያ ባለው አደባባይ ይበሉታል።

verses.en: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.
verses.am: በእርሾ ቦክቶ አይጋገርም። እርሱን ከእሳቱ ቍርባኔ ለእነርሱ እድል ፈንታ እንዲሆን ሰጠሁ፤ እርሱም እንደ ኃጢአትና እንደ በደል መሥዋዕት ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of YAHUAH made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ከቀረበ ከእሳት ቍርባን ለዘላለም ለልጅ ልጃችሁ እድል ፈንታቸው እንዲሆን ከአሮን ልጆች ወንዶቹ ሁሉ ይበሉታል። የሚነካቸው ሁሉ ቅዱስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto YAHUAH in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
verses.am: በተቀቡበት ቀን የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል መልካሙን ዱቄት እኵሌታውን በጥዋት፥ እኵሌታውንም በማታ ለዘወትር የእህል ቍርባን አድርገው ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርቡት የአሮንና የልጆቹ ቍርባን ይህ ነው።

verses.en: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከዘይት ጋር በምጣድ ላይ ይደረጋል፤ ሲለወስ ታገባዋለህ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የእህሉን ቍርባን ቈራርሰህ ታቀርበዋለህ።

verses.en: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto YAHUAH; it shall be wholly burnt.
verses.am: ከልጆቹም በአባቱ ፋንታ የተቀባው ካህን ያቀርበዋል። ለዘላለም ሥርዓት እንዲሆን ፈጽሞ ለእግዚአብሔር ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
verses.am: ካህኑም የሚያቀርበው የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ ፈጽሞ ይቃጠላል፤ ከእርሱም አንዳች አይበላም።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before YAHUAH: it is most holy.
verses.am: አሮንንና ልጆቹን እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ የኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይታረዳል፤ እርሱ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: ለኃጢአት የሚሠዋው ካህን ይበላዋል፤ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዙሪያ ባለው አደባባይ በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይበላል።

verses.en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
verses.am: ሥጋውን የሚነካ ሁሉ ቅዱስ ይሆናል፤ ማናቸው ልብስ ደም ቢረጭበት የተረጨበትን በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ታጥበዋለህ።

verses.en: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.am: የሚቀቀልበትም ሸክላ ይሰበራል፤ በናስም ዕቃ ቢቀቀል ይፈገፈጋል፥ በውኃም ይለቀለቃል።

verses.en: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
verses.am: ከካህናት ወገን የሆነ ወንድ ሁሉ ከእርሱ ይበላል፤ እርሱ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በመቅደሱ ውስጥ ለማስተስረያ ይሆን ዘንድ ከደሙ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን የሚገባው የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሁሉ አይበላም፤ በእሳት ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.
verses.am: የበደል መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት በሚያርዱበት ስፍራ የበደሉን መሥዋዕት ያርዱታል፤ ደሙንም በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጨዋል።

verses.en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
verses.am: ስቡንም ሁሉ፥ ላቱንም፥ የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶቹ ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto YAHUAH: it is a trespass offering.
verses.am: ካህኑም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ እርሱ የበደል መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.
verses.am: ከካህናት ወገን የሆነ ወንድ ሁሉ ይበላዋል፤ በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይበሉታል፤ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.
verses.am: የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት እንደ ሆነ እንዲሁ የበደል መሥዋዕት ነው፤ ለሁለቱ አንድ ሕግ ነው፤ በእርሱ የሚያስተሰርይ ካህን ይወስደዋል።

verses.en: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
verses.am: የማናቸውንም ሰው የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርብ ካህን ያቀረበው የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ቁርበት ለዚያው ካህን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.
verses.am: በእቶን የተጋገረው የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ፥ በመቀቀያም ወይም በምጣድ የበሰለው ሁሉ ለሚያቀርበው ካህን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.
verses.am: በዘይትም የተለወሰው ወይም የደረቀው የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ ለአሮን ልጆች ሁሉ ይሆናል፤ ለሁሉም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሰው ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርበው የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
verses.am: ለምስጋና ቢያቀርበው፥ ከምስጋናው መሥዋዕት ጋር በዘይት የተለወሰ የቂጣ እንጎቻ፥ በዘይትም የተቀባ ስስ ቂጣ፥ በዘይትም የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት ያቀርባል።

verses.en: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
verses.am: ለምስጋና የሚሆነውን የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ባቀረበ ጊዜ እርሾ ያለበትን ኅብስት ያቀርባል።

verses.en: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto YAHUAH, and it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.am: ከቍርባኑም ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን እንዲሆን ከእነርሱ አንዱን ያነሣል። እርሱም የደኅንነትን መሥዋዕት ደም ለሚረጨው ካህን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.am: ለምስጋና የሚሆነው የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ በሚቀርብበት ቀን ይበሉታል፤ ከእርሱ እስከ ነገ ምንም አያድርም።

verses.en: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
verses.am: የቍርባኑም መሥዋዕት የስእለት ወይም የፈቃድ ቢሆን፥ መሥዋዕቱ በሚቀርብበት ቀን ይብሉት፤ ከእርሱም የቀረውን በነጋው ይብሉት፤

verses.en: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.am: ከመሥዋዕቱም ሥጋ እስከ ሦስተኛው ቀን የሚቆየው በእሳት ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.am: በሦስተኛው ቀን ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ፥ አይሠምርም፤ ላቀረበው ሰው የተጠላ ይሆንበታል እንጂ ቍርባን ሆኖ አይቈጠርለትም፤ ከእርሱም ቢበላ ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል።

verses.en: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
verses.am: ርኩስ ነገር የሚነካውን ሥጋ አይብሉት፤ በእሳት ይቃጠል። ንጹሕ የሆነ ሰው ሁሉ ግን ከሥጋው ይብላ።

verses.en: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto YAHUAH, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.am: ሰውም የረከሰ ቢሆን፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ከሆነው ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ፥ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto YAHUAH, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.am: ማናቸውንም ርኵስ ነገር ቢነካ፥ የሰውን ወይም የረከሰን እንስሳ ወይም ሌላውን የተጠላ ርኩስን ቢነካ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ከሆነው ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ፥ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
verses.am: የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። የበሬ ወይም የበግ ወይም የፍየል ስብ ከቶ አትብሉ።

verses.en: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.am: የሞተውን ስብ፥ አውሬ የሰበረውንም ስብ ለሌላ ተግባር አድርጉት፤ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ምንም አትብሉ፤

verses.en: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto YAHUAH, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር በእሳት ከሚቀርበው ከእንስሳ ስብ የሚበላ ሁሉ፥ ያ የበላ ሰው ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጠፋልና።

verses.en: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.am: በማደሪያዎቻችሁም ሁሉ የወፍ ወይም የእንስሳ ደም ቢሆን አትብሉ።

verses.en: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.am: ደም የሚበላ ሰው ሁሉ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto YAHUAH shall bring his oblation unto YAHUAH of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.am: የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። ለእግዚአብሔር የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርብ ሰው ቍርባኑን ለእግዚአብሔር ከደኅንነቱ መሥዋዕት ያመጣል።

verses.en: His own hands shall bring the offerings of YAHUAH made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before YAHUAH.
verses.am: የእርሱ እጆች ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳቱን ቍርባን ያመጣሉ፤ ፍርምባው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ይወዘውዝ ዘንድ ስቡንና ፍርምባውን ያመጣል።

verses.en: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
verses.am: ካህኑም ስቡን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥላል፤ ፍርምባውም ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ይሁን።

verses.en: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.am: ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕታችሁ ቀኝ ወርቹን ለማንሣት ቍርባን እንዲሆን ለካህኑ ትሰጡታላችሁ።

verses.en: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
verses.am: ከአሮንም ልጆች የደኅንነትን መሥዋዕት ደሙንና ስቡን ለሚያቀርብ ለእርሱ ቀኝ ወርቹ እድል ፈንታው ይሆናል።

verses.en: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Yisra'el from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: የሚወዘወዘውን ፍርምባና የሚነሣውን ወርች ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕታቸው ወስጄአለሁ፥ ለካህኑ ለአሮንና ለልጆቹም ለዘላለም እድል ፈንታ እንዲሆን ከእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ሰጥቼአቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of YAHUAH made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto YAHUAH in the priest's office;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በክህነት ያገለግሉት ዘንድ ባቀረባቸው ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር ከሆነ ከእሳት ቍርባን የአሮንና የልጆቹ እድል ፈንታ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Which YAHUAH commanded to be given them of the children of Yisra'el, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
verses.am: ለልጅ ልጃቸው ለዘላለም እድል ፈንታቸው እንዲሆን በቀባቸው ቀን የእስራኤል ልጆች ይሰጡአቸው ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ይህ ነው።

verses.en: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
verses.am: የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና የእህል ቍርባን፥ የኃጢአትና የበደል መሥዋዕት፥ የቅድስናና የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Which YAHUAH commanded Mosheh in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Yisra'el to offer their oblations unto YAHUAH, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሲና ምድረ በዳ ቍርባናቸውን ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርቡ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ባዘዘ ጊዜ በሲና ተራራ ለሙሴ ያዘዘው ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
verses.am: አሮንን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ልጆቹን፥ ልብሱንም፥ የቅብዓቱንም ዘይት፥ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕትም የሆነውን ወይፈን፥ ሁለቱንም አውራ በጎች፥ የቂጣውንም እንጀራ ሌማት ውሰድ፤

verses.en: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: ማኅበሩንም ሁሉ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ሰብስባቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh did as YAHUAH commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው አደረገ፤ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto the congregation, This is the thing which YAHUAH commanded to be done.
verses.am: ሙሴም ማኅበሩን። እግዚአብሔር ይደረግ ዘንድ ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንንና ልጆቹን አቀረበ፥ በውኃም አጠባቸው።

verses.en: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
verses.am: ሸሚዝም አለበሰው፥ በመታጠቂያም አስታጠቀው፥ ቀሚስም አለበሰው፥ ኤፉድም ደረበለት፥ በብልሃትም በተጠለፈ ቋድ አስታጠቀውና በእርሱ ላይ አሰረው።

verses.en: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.am: የደረት ኪስ በእርሱ ላይ አደረገ፤ በደረቱ ኪስም ውስጥ ኡሪምንና ቱሚምን አኖረበት።

verses.en: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው በራሱ ላይ መጠምጠሚያውን አደረገ፤ በመጠምጠሚያውም ላይ በፊቱ በኩል የተቀደሰውን አክሊል፥ ቅጠል የሚመስለውን የወርቅ ምልክት፥ አደረገ።

verses.en: And Mosheh took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
verses.am: ሙሴም የቅብዓቱን ዘይት ወሰደ፥ ማደሪያውንና በውስጡ ያለውን ሁሉ ቀብቶ ቀደሳቸው።

verses.en: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በመሠዊያው ላይ ሰባት ጊዜ ረጨ፤ ይቀድሳቸውም ዘንድ መሠዊያውንና ዕቃውን ሁሉ፥ የመታጠቢያውን ሰንና መቀመጫውን ቀባ።

verses.en: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
verses.am: ከቅብዓቱም ዘይት በአሮን ራስ ላይ አፈሰሰ፥ ይቀድሰውም ዘንድ ቀባው።

verses.en: And Mosheh brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሙሴ የአሮንን ልጆች አቀረበ፥ ቀሚሶችንም አለበሳቸው፥ በመታጠቂያም አስታጠቃቸው፥ ቆብም ደፋባቸው።

verses.en: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
verses.am: የኃጢአትንም መሥዋዕት ወይፈን አቀረበ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም በኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት ወይፈን ራስ ላይ እጆቻቸውን ጫኑ።

verses.en: And he slew it; and Mosheh took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
verses.am: አረደውም፤ ሙሴም ደሙን ወስዶ በጣቱ የመሠዊያውን ቀንዶች ዙሪያ ቀባ፥ መሠዊያውንም አነጻው፤ ደሙንም ከመሠዊያው በታች አፈሰሰው፥ ያስተሰርይለትም ዘንድ ቀደሰው።

verses.en: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Mosheh burned it upon the altar.
verses.am: በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥ የጕበቱንም መረብ፥ ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች ስባቸውንም ወሰደ፤ ሙሴም በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.en: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ወይፈኑን፥ ቁርበቱንም፥ ሥጋውንም፥ ፈርሱንም ከሰፈሩ ውጭ በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.en: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.am: ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትም የሚሆን አውራ በግ አቀረበ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም በአውራው በግ ራስ ላይ እጆቻቸውን ጫኑ።

verses.en: And he killed it; and Mosheh sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.am: አረደውም፤ ሙሴም ደሙን በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ረጨው።

verses.en: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Mosheh burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
verses.am: አውራውንም በግ በየብልቱ ቈረጠ፤ ሙሴም ጭንቅላቱን ብልቶቹንም ስቡንም አቃጠለ።

verses.en: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Mosheh burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto YAHUAH; as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh.
verses.am: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹንም በውኃ አጠበ፤ ሙሴም አውራውን በግ ሁሉ በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው፤ ይህ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን ነበረ።

verses.en: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.am: ለቅድስናም የሚሆነውን ሁለተኛውን አውራ በግ አቀረበ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም በአውራው በግ ራስ ላይ እጆቻቸውን ጫኑ።

verses.en: And he slew it; and Mosheh took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.am: አረደውም፤ ሙሴን ከደሙ ወስዶ የአሮንን የቀኝ ጆሮውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንም አውራ ጣት የቀኝ እግሩንም አውራ ጣት አስነካው።

verses.en: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Mosheh put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Mosheh sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.am: የአሮንንም ልጆች አቀረበ፤ ሙሴም የቀኝ ጆሮአቸውን ጫፍ፥ የቀን እጃቸውንም አውራ ጣት፥ የቀኝ እግራቸውንም አውራ ጣት ከደሙ አስነካ፤ ሙሴም ደሙን በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ረጨ።

verses.en: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
verses.am: ስቡንና ላቱን፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥ የጕበቱንም መረብ፥ ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች ስባቸውንም፥ ቀኝ ወርቹንም ወሰደ፤

verses.en: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before YAHUAH, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ካለው ከቂጣው እንጀራ ሌማት አንድ የቂጣ እንጐቻ፥ አንድም የዘይት እንጀራ፥ አንድም ስስ ቂጣ ወስዶ በስቡና በቀኝ ወርቹ ላይ አኖራቸው።

verses.en: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them for a wave offering before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሁሉንም በአሮንና በልጆቹ እጆች ላይ አደረገ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ወዘወዛቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከእጃቸው ተቀብሎ በመሠዊያው በሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ላይ አቃጠለው፤ የጣፋጭ ሽታ መቀደሻ ነበረ። እርሱም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቁርባን ነበረ።

verses.en: And Mosheh took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before YAHUAH: for of the ram of consecration it was Mosheh' part; as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh.
verses.am: ሙሴም ፍርምባውን ወስዶ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ወዘወዘው፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ይህ ለቅድስና ከታረደው አውራ በግ የሙሴ እድል ፈንታ ሆነ።

verses.en: And Mosheh took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከቅብዓቱ ዘይትና በመሠዊያው ላይ ካለው ከደሙ ወስዶ በአሮንና በልብሱ ላይ፥ በልጆቹና በልጆቹ ልብስ ላይ ረጨው፤ አሮንንና ልብሱንም፥ ልጆቹንም የልጆቹንም ልብስ ቀደሰ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንንና ልጆቹን አላቸው። ሥጋውን በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ቀቅሉ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹ ይበሉታል ብዬ እንዳዘዝሁ በዚያ እርሱንና በሌማቱ ያለውን የቅድስናውን እንጀራ ብሉ።

verses.en: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
verses.am: ከሥጋውና ከእንጀራውም የተረፈውን በእሳት ታቃጥሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀን ይክናችኋልና የክህነታችሁ ቀን እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ሰባት ቀን ከማኅበሩ ድንኳን ደጃፍ አትውጡ።

verses.en: As he hath done this day, so YAHUAH hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
verses.am: በዚህ ቀን እንደ ተደረገ ለእናንተ ለማስተስረያ ይደረግ ዘንድ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር አዘዘ።

verses.en: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of YAHUAH, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ አዝዞኛልና እንዳትሞቱ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ሌሊቱንና ቀኑን ሰባት ቀን ተቀመጡ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥርዓት ጠብቁ።

verses.en: So Aaron and his sons did all things which YAHUAH commanded by the hand of Mosheh.
verses.am: አሮንና ልጆቹም እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Mosheh called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Yisra'el;
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ሙሴ አሮንንና ልጆቹን የእስራኤልንም ሽማግሌዎች ጠራ።

verses.en: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before YAHUAH.
verses.am: አሮንንም አለው። ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ከመንጋው እምቦሳውን፥ ስለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት አውራውን በግ ነውር የሌለባቸውን ወስደህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቅርባቸው።

verses.en: And unto the children of Yisra'el thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም ልጆች። ዛሬ እግዚአብሔር ይገለጥላችኋልና ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አውራ ፍየልን፥ ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት ነውር የሌለባቸውን አንድ ዓመት የሆናቸውን እምቦሳና ጠቦትን፥ ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት በሬንና አውራን በግ፥ በዘይትም የተለወሰ የእህልን ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይሠዉ ዘንድ ውሰዱ ብለህ ንገራቸው።

verses.en: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before YAHUAH; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day YAHUAH will appear unto you.
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም ልጆች። ዛሬ እግዚአብሔር ይገለጥላችኋልና ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አውራ ፍየልን፥ ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት ነውር የሌለባቸውን አንድ ዓመት የሆናቸውን እምቦሳና ጠቦትን፥ ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት በሬንና አውራን በግ፥ በዘይትም የተለወሰ የእህልን ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይሠዉ ዘንድ ውሰዱ ብለህ ንገራቸው።

verses.en: And they brought that which Mosheh commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሙሴም ያዘዛቸውን ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አመጡ፤ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ ቀርበው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቆሙ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said, This is the thing which YAHUAH commanded that ye should do: and the glory of YAHUAH shall appear unto you.
verses.am: ሙሴም። ታደርጉት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ይህ ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ይገለጥላችኋል አለ።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as YAHUAH commanded.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን። ወደ መሠዊያው ቀርበህ የኃጢአትህን መሥዋዕትና የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትህን ሠዋ፥ ለራስህና ለሕዝቡም አስተስርይ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዘ የሕዝቡን ቍርባን አቅርብ አስተስርይላቸውም አለው።

verses.en: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
verses.am: አሮንም ወደ መሠዊያው ቀርቦ ስለ ራሱ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሆነውን እምቦሳ አረደ።

verses.en: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን አቀረቡለት፤ ጣቱንም በደሙ ውስጥ ነክሮ የመሠዊያውን ቀንዶች አስነካ፥ ደሙንም ከመሠዊያው በታች አፈሰሰው።

verses.en: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as YAHUAH commanded Mosheh.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ከኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት ስቡንና ኵላሊቶቹን፥ የጕበቱንም መረብ በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለ።

verses.en: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
verses.am: ሥጋውንና ቁርበቱንም ከሰፈሩ ውጭ በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.en: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አረደ፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን አመጡለት፥ እርሱም በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ረጨው።

verses.en: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት በየብልቱ፥ ራሱንም አመጡለት፤ እርሱም በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.en: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.am: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹንም አጠበ፤ በመሠዊያውም በሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.en: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
verses.am: የሕዝቡንም ቍርባን አቀረበ፤ ስለ ሕዝቡ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሆነውን ፍየል ወስዶ አረደው፥ ስለ ኃጢአትም እንደ ፊተኛው ሠዋው።

verses.en: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አቀረበ፥ እንደ ሥርዓቱም አደረገው።

verses.en: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
verses.am: የእህሉንም ቍርባን አቀረበ፥ ከእርሱም እፍኝ ሙሉ ወስዶ በጥዋት ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ሌላ በመሰዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.en: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
verses.am: ስለ ሕዝቡ የሆነውን የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት በሬውንና አውራውን በግ አረደ፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን አመጡለት፥

verses.en: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
verses.am: በመሠዊያውም ላይ በዙሪያው ረጨው፤ የበሬውንና የአራውንም በግ ስብ፥ ላቱንም፥ የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ ኩላሊቶቹንም፥ የጉበቱንም መረብ አመጡለት።

verses.en: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
verses.am: ስቡንም በፍርምባዎቹ ላይ አደረጉ፥ ስቡንም በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለ፤

verses.en: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before YAHUAH; as Mosheh commanded.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው አሮን ፍርምባዎቹንና ቀኝ ወርቹን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቁርባን ወዘወዘው።

verses.en: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
verses.am: አሮንም እጆቹን ወደ ሕዝቡ ዘረጋ ባረካቸውም፤ የኃጢያቱን የሚቃጠለውንም የደኅንነቱንም መሥዋዕት ከሠዋ በኋላ ወረደ።

verses.en: And Mosheh and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of YAHUAH appeared unto all the people.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ገቡ፤ ወጡም፥ ሕዝቡንም ባረኩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ተገለጠ።

verses.en: And there came a fire out from before YAHUAH, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
verses.am: እሳትም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጣ፥ በመሠዊያውም ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ስቡንም በላ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አይተው እልል አሉ፥ በግምባራቸውም ወደቁ።

verses.en: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before YAHUAH, which he commanded them not.
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጆች ናዳብና አብዩድ በየራሳቸው ጥናውን ወስደው እሳት አደረጉበት፥ በላዩም ዕጣን አኖሩበት፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት እርሱ ያላዘዛቸውን ሌላ እሳት አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And there went out fire from YAHUAH, and devoured them, and they died before YAHUAH.
verses.am: እሳትም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጥቶ በላቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ሞቱ።

verses.en: Then Mosheh said unto Aaron, This is it that YAHUAH spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን። እግዚአብሔር። ወደ እኔ በሚቀርቡ እቀድሳለሁ፥ በሕዝቡም ሁሉ ፊት እከብራለሁ ብሎ የተናገረው ይህ ነው አለው፤ አሮንም ዝም አለ

verses.en: And Mosheh called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
verses.am: ሙሴም የአሮንን አጎት የዑዝኤልን ልጆች ሚሳኤልንና ኤልጻፋንን ጠርቶ። ቅረቡ፥ ወንድሞቻችሁንም ከመቅደሱ ፊት አንሥታችሁ ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ ውሰዱአቸው አላቸው።

verses.en: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Mosheh had said.
verses.am: እነርሱም ቀርበው አነሡአቸው፥ ሙሴም እንዳለ በቀሚሳቸው ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ ወሰዱአቸው።

verses.en: And Mosheh said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Yisra'el, bewail the burning which YAHUAH hath kindled.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን፥ ልጆቹንም አልዓዛርንና ኢታምርን። እንዳትሞቱ በማኅበሩም ሁሉ ላይ ቁጣ እንዳይወርድ ራሳችሁን አትንጩ፥ ልብሳችሁንም አትቅደዱ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስላቃጠለው ማቃጠል ግን ወንድሞቻችሁ የእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ያልቅሱ።

verses.en: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of YAHUAH is upon you. And they did according to the word of Mosheh.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር የቅብዓት ዘይት በላያችሁ ነውና እንዳትሞቱ ከመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አትወጡም አላቸው። እንደ ሙሴ ቃልም አደረጉ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Aaron, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
verses.am: እንዳትሞቱ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ስትገቡ አንተና ልጆችህ የወይን ጠጅና የሚያሰክርን ነገር ሁሉ አትጠጡ፤ ይህም ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል፤

verses.en: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
verses.am: በተቀደሰውና ባልተቀደሰው፥ በርኩሱና በንጹሑም መካከል ትለያላችሁ፤

verses.en: And that ye may teach the children of Yisra'el all the statutes which YAHUAH hath spoken unto them by the hand of Mosheh.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሙሴ ቃል የነገራቸውን ሥርዓት ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ታስተምራላችሁ።

verses.en: And Mosheh spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of YAHUAH made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን፥ የተረፉለትንም ልጆቹን አልዓዛርንና ኢታምርን አላቸው። ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነውና ለእግዚአብሔር ከሆነው ከእሳት ቁርባን የቀረውን የእህሉን ቁርባን ውሰዱ፥ ቂጣም አድርጋችሁ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ብሉት እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አዞኛል፥

verses.en: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of YAHUAH made by fire: for so I am commanded.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ከሆነው ከእሳት ቁርባን ለአንተም ለልጆችህም የተሰጠ ሥርዓት ነውና በቅዱስ ስፍራ ትበሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons' due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እነዚህም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕቶች ለአንተና ለልጆችህ ሥርዓት እንዲሆኑ ስለ ተሰጡ፥ የሚወዘወዘውን ፍርምባ፥ የሚነሣውንም ወርች አንተ፥ ከአንተ ጋርም ልጆችህ፥ ሴቶች ልጆችህም በንጹሕ ስፍራ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before YAHUAH; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as YAHUAH hath commanded.
verses.am: የሚነሣውን ወርች የሚወዘወዘውንም ፍርምባ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቁርባን እንዲወዘውዙ የእሳት ቁርባን ከሆነው ስብ ጋር ያመጣሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ ለአንተ ከአንተ ጋርም ለልጆችህ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And Mosheh diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,
verses.am: ሙሴም የኃጢያቱን መሥዋዕት ፍየል እጅግ ፈለገው፥ እነሆም ተቃጥሎ ነበር፤ ሙሴም የቀሩትን የአሮንን ልጆች አልአዛርንና ኢታምርን ተቈጥቶ።

verses.en: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and YAHUAH hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before YAHUAH?
verses.am: ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነውና፥ የሕዝቡንም ኃጢያት እንድትሸከሙ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት እንድታስተሰርዩላቸው ለእናንተ ሰጥቶታልና ስለ ምን የኃጢያትን መሥዋዕት በቅዱሱ ስፍራ አልበላችሁም?

verses.en: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.
verses.am: እነሆ ደሙን ወደ መቅደሱ ውስጥ አላገባችሁትም፤ እኔ እንዳዘዝሁ በቅዱሱ ስፍራ ውስጥ ትበሉት ዘንድ ይገባችሁ ነበር አላቸው።

verses.en: And Aaron said unto Mosheh, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before YAHUAH; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of YAHUAH?
verses.am: አሮንም ሙሴን። እነሆ ዛሬ የኃጢያታቸውን መሥዋዕት፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕታቸውን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቀረቡ፤ ይህም ሁሉ ደረሰብኝ፤ ዛሬስ የኃጢያት መሥዋዕት በበላሁ ኖሮ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካም ኖሮአልን? አለው።

verses.en: And when Mosheh heard that, he was content.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሰማ በፊቱም መልካም ሆነ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh and to Aaron, saying unto them,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ በሉአቸው። ከምድር እንስሶች ሁሉ የምትበሉአቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
verses.am: የተሰነጠቀ ሰኮና ያለውንና የሚያመሰኳውን እንስሳ ሁሉ ብሉ።

verses.en: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከሚያመሰኩት፥ ሰኮናቸው ስንጥቅ ከሆነው ከእነዚህ አትበሉም፤ ግመል ያመሰኳል፥ ነገር ግን ሰኮናው ስላልተሰነጠቀ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.am: ሽኮኮ ያመሰኳል፥ ነገር ግን ሰኰናው ስላልተሰነጠቀ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.am: ጥንቸልም ያመሰኳል፥ ነገር ግን ሰኮናው ስላልተሰነጠቀ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.
verses.am: እርያም ሰኮናው ተሰንጥቋል፥ ነገር ግን ስለማያመሰኳ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.
verses.am: የእነዚህን ሥጋ አትበሉም፥ በድናቸውንም አትነኩም፤ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ናቸው።

verses.en: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.
verses.am: በውኃ ውስጥ ከሚኖሩት ሁሉ እነዚህን ትበላላችሁ በውኆች በባሕሮችም በወንዞችም ውስጥ ከሚኖሩት ሁሉ ክንፍና ቅርፊት ያላቸውን ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:
verses.am: በውኆቹ ውስጥ ከሚንቀሳቀሱ፥ በውኆች ውስጥ የሕይወት ነፍስ ካላቸው ሁሉ፥ በባሕሮችና በወንዞች ውስጥ ክንፍና ቅርፊት የሌላቸው ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፉ ናቸው።

verses.en: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
verses.am: በእናንተም ዘንድ የተጸየፉ ይሆናሉ፤ ሥጋቸውንም አትበሉም፥ በድናቸውንም ትጸየፋላችሁ።

verses.en: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.am: ክንፍና ቅርፊትም የሌላቸው በውኃ ውስጥ የሚኖሩት ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፉ ናቸው።

verses.en: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
verses.am: ከወፎችም ወገን የምትጸየፉአቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ አይበሉም፤ የተጸየፉ ናቸው፤

verses.en: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
verses.am: ንስር፥ ገዲ፥ ዓሣ አውጭ፥ ጭላት፥ ጭልፊት በየወገኑ፥

verses.en: Every raven after his kind;
verses.am: ቁራ ሁሉ በየወገኑ፥

verses.en: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
verses.am: ሰጎን፥ ጠላቋ፥ ዝዪ፥ በቋል በየወገኑ፥

verses.en: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
verses.am: ይብራ፥ ጥምብ አንሣ አሞራ፥ ሽመላ፥ ሳቢሳ በየወገኑ፥ ጅንጁላቴ ወፍ፥ የሌሊት ወፍ።

verses.en: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
verses.am: ይብራ፥ ጥምብ አንሣ አሞራ፥ ሽመላ፥ ሳቢሳ በየወገኑ፥ ጅንጁላቴ ወፍ፥ የሌሊት ወፍ።

verses.en: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
verses.am: የሚበርርም፥ በአራት እግሮችም የሚሔድ ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፈ ነው።

verses.en: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከሚበርሩት፥ አራትም እግሮች ካሉአቸው፥ ከእግሮቻቸውም በላይ በምድር ላይ የሚዘልሉባቸው ጭኖች ካሉአቸው ተንቀሳቃሾች እነዚህን ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
verses.am: ከእነርሱም እነዚህን ትበላላችሁ፤ አራቱን ዓይነት አንበጣዎች በየወገናቸው።

verses.en: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሚበርር፥ አራትም እግሮች ያሉት ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፈ ነው።

verses.en: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.am: በእነዚህም ርኩስ ትሆናላችሁ፤ የእነርሱንም በድን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም በድን የሚያነሣ ሁሉ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.am: ሰኮናም ያለው፥ ነገር ግን ሰኮናው ያልተሰነጠቀ፥ የማያመሰኳም እንሰሳ ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው፤ እርሱን የሚነካ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
verses.am: በአራት እግሮቹ ከሚሄድ እንስሳ ሁሉ በመዳፎቹ ላይ የሚሄድ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው፤ የእርሱን በድን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
verses.am: በድናቸውንም የሚያነሣ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው። እነርሱም በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ናቸው።

verses.en: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
verses.am: በምድር ላይም ከሚንቀሳቀስ ተንቀሳቅሳሽ እነዚህ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ናቸው፤ ሙጭልጭላ፥ አይጥ፥ እንሽላሊት በየወገኑ፥

verses.en: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
verses.am: ኤሊ፥ አዞ፥ ገበሎ፥ አርጃኖ፥ እስስት።

verses.en: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
verses.am: ከሚንቀሳቀሱት ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች የሚሆኑ እነዚህ ናቸው። ከእነርሱም የሞተውን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የሞተውን የሚነካ በምንም ላይ ቢወድቅ እርሱ ርኩስ ነው፤ የእንጨት ዕቃ ወይም ልብስ ወይም ቁርበት ወይም ከረጢት ቢሆን የሚሠራበት ዕቃ ሁሉ እርሱ በውኃ ውስጥ ይደረግ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዳች በውስጡ የወደቀበትን የሸክላውን ዕቃ ሁሉ ስበሩት፥ በውስጡም ያለው ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
verses.am: በእርሱ ውስጥ ያለው፥ ውኃም የሚፈስስበት የሚበላ መብል ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ በዚህም ዕቃ ሁሉ ያለው የሚጠጣ መጠጥ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
verses.am: ከእነዚህም በድን የሚወድቅበት ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ እቶን ወይም ምድጃ ቢሆን ይሰባበራል፤ ርኩሶች ናቸው፤ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ምንጩ፥ ጕድጓዱም፥ የውኃውም ኵሬ ንጹሐን ናቸው፤ በድናቸውን ግን የሚነካ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
verses.am: ከበድናቸውም በሚዘራ ዘር ላይ አንዳች ቢወድቅ እርሱ ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.en: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በዘሩ ላይ ውኃ ቢፈስስበት፥ ከዚህ በኋላ ከበድናቸው አንዳች ቢወድቅበት፥ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
verses.am: ለመብል ከሚሆኑላችሁ እንስሶች የሞተ ቢኖር፥ በድኑን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
verses.am: ከበድኑም የሚበላ ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ በድኑንም የሚያነሣ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.am: በምድርም ላይ የሚንቀሳቀስ ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ የተጸየፈ ነው፥ አትብሉትም።

verses.en: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
verses.am: በሆዱ የሚሳብ፥ በአራትም እግሮች የሚሳብ፥ ብዙ እግሮችም ያሉት፥ በምድርም ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ተንቀሳቃሾች ሁሉ የተጸየፉ ናቸውና አትብሉአቸው።

verses.en: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
verses.am: በሚንቀሳቀሱ ተንቀሳቃሾች ሁሉ ሰውነታችሁን አታስጸይፉ፤ በእነርሱም እንዳትረክሱ ሰውነታችሁን አታርክሱባቸው።

verses.en: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝና፤ ሰውነታችሁን ቀድሱ፥ ቅዱሳንም ሁኑ፥ እኔ ቅዱስ ነኝና፤ በምድርም ላይ በሚሳብ ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ ሰውነታችሁን አታርክሱ።

verses.en: For I am YAHUAH your YAHUAH: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.am: እኔ አምላካችሁ እሆን ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ እንግዲህ እኔ ቅዱስ ነኝና እናንተ ቅዱሳን ሁኑ።

verses.en: For I am YAHUAH that bringeth you up out of the land of Mitsrayim, to be your YAHUAH: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
verses.am: የእንስሳና የወፍ፥ በውኃም ውስጥ የሚንቀሳቀስ የፍጥረት ሁሉ፥ በምድርም ላይ የሚንቀሳቀስ የፍጥረት ሁሉ ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:
verses.am: በርኩስና በንጹሕ መካከል፥ የሕይወት ነፍስ ካላቸውም በምትበሉትና በማትበሉት መካከል እንድትለዩ ነው።

verses.en: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Yisra'el, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ሴት ብታረግዝ ወንድ ልጅም ብትወልድ፥ ሰባት ቀን ያህል የረከሰች ናት፤ እንደ ሕመምዋ መርገም ወራት ትረክሳለች።

verses.en: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ልጁ ከሥጋው ሸለፈት ይገረዝ።

verses.en: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
verses.am: ከደምዋም እስክትነጻ ሠላሳ ሦስት ቀን ትቀመጥ፤ የመንጻትዋ ቀንም እስኪፈጸም ድረስ የተቀደሰን ነገር አትንካ፥ ወደ መቅደስም አትግባ።

verses.en: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
verses.am: ሴት ልጅም ብትወልድ እንደ መርገምዋ ወራት ሁለት ሳምንት ያህል የረከሰች ናት፤ ከደምዋም እስክትነጻ ድረስ ስድሳ ስድስት ቀን ትቀመጥ።

verses.en: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:
verses.am: የመንጻትዋ ወራትም በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ ለወንድ ልጅ ወይም ለሴት ልጅ፥ የአንድ ዓመት ጠቦት ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት፥ የርግብም ግልገል ወይም ዋኖስ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ወደ ካህኑ ታምጣለት።

verses.en: Who shall offer it before YAHUAH, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.
verses.am: እርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቀርበዋል ያስተሰርይላትማል፤ ከደምዋም ፈሳሽ ትነጻለች። ወንድ ወይም ሴት ለምትወልድ ሴት ሕጉ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
verses.am: ጠቦት ለማምጣት ገንዘብዋ ያልበቃት እንደ ሆነ ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች፥ አንዱን ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ሌላውንም ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ታቀርባለች፤ ካህኑም ያስተሰርይላታል፥ እርስዋም ትነጻለች።

verses.en: And YAHUAH spake unto Mosheh and Aaron, saying,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ እባጭ ወይም ብጕር ወይም ቋቁቻ ቢታይ፥ በሥጋው ቁርበት እንደ ለምጽ ደዌ ቢመስል፥ ወደ ካህኑ ወደ አሮን ወይም ከካህናቱ ልጆቹ ወደ አንዱ ያምጡት።

verses.en: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.am: ካህኑም በሥጋው ቁርበት ያለውን ደዌ ያያል፤ ጠጕሩም ተለውጦ ቢነጣ ደዌውም ወደ ሥጋው ቁርበት ቢጠልቅ፥ እርሱ የለምጽ ደዌ ነው፤ ካህኑም አይቶ። ርኩስ ነው ይበለው።

verses.en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:
verses.am: ቋቁቻውም በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ ቢነጣ፥ ከቁርበቱም የጠለቀ ባይመስል፥ ጠጕሩም ባይነጣ፥ ካህኑ የታመመውን ሰው ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ካህኑ ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው በዓይኑ ፊት እንደ ነበረ ቢሆን፥ በቁርበቱም ላይ ባይሰፋ፥ ካህኑ ሰባት ቀን ደግሞ ይዘጋበታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.am: ደግሞ በሰባተኛው ቀን ካህኑ ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው ቢከስም፥ ደዌውም በቁርበቱ ላይ ባይሰፋ፥ ካህኑ። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል፤ እከክ ነው፤ ልብሱንም አጥቦ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:
verses.am: ስለ መንጻቱ በካህኑ ዘንድ ከታየ በኋላ እከኩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ቢሰፋ፥ እንደ ገና ሊታይ ወደ ካህኑ ይቀርባል።

verses.en: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.
verses.am: ካህኑም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ እከኩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ቢሰፋ፥ ካህኑ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ ለምጽ ነው።

verses.en: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
verses.am: የለምጽ ደዌ በሰው ውስጥ ቢሆን እርሱን ወደ ካህኑ ያመጡለታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;
verses.am: ካህኑም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ በቁርበቱ ላይ ነጭ እባጭ ቢሆን፥ ጠጕሩም ተለውጦ ቢነጣ፥ ሥጋውም በእባጩ ውስጥ ቢያዥ፥

verses.en: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.
verses.am: እርሱ በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ አሮጌ ለምጽ ነው፥ ካህኑም። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ እርሱ ርኩስ ነውና አይዘጋበትም።
